## Change and approved scope

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. For a notebook review,
list the author-selected finding IDs or explicit scope.

## Validation

Record the notebook executed, command, fresh-kernel result, and any targeted
checks. State whether rendered equations/tables/plots were visually inspected;
do not equate execution with visual verification.

## Deferred findings and limitations

List unselected suggestions and material assumptions. Do not add mandatory
reading/exercise sections or distance verification without author approval.

## Merge destination

Target the branch that owns the notebook. Publication to `main` occurs only when
explicitly requested. Leave merging to the author's explicit approval.
